title: Apply for a NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card
summary: Learn about and apply for a free NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card, which provides discounts and special offers across NSW.
intro:
As a NSW permanent resident aged 60 or over, you can apply for either a NSW Seniors Card or Senior Savers Card.

Both cards are free and give you discounts and special offers at thousands of businesses across NSW including shops, restaurants and professional services. Many interstate businesses also provide discounts on request.

The NSW Seniors Card gives you access to the Gold Opal Card and public transport concessions Australia-wide. The NSW Senior Savers Card does not offer this benefit.

You can apply online, in person or by phone.

For more information, visit the Seniors Card website.
who_can_apply: Must be aged 60 or over, or turning 60 within 3 weeks.
Must be an Australian citizen or permanent resident.
If applying for a NSW Seniors Card, you must not be working at all or average 20 hours or less of paid work across a 12-month period.
If applying for a NSW Senior Savers Card, you must average more than 20 hours a week of paid work across a 12-month period.
what_you_need: A MyServiceNSW Account (unless applying by phone).
Australian certificate of registration by descent
Health Care Card or Seniors Health Card

how_to_steps.text: Check you meet the eligibility requirements.
Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Complete and submit the online form.
